info.body:
Records lcy's completed Fashionpedia eight-class segmentation work and the revised preparation plan. C5k completed; D10k was stopped by the user. Full-data training remains unstarted.

### Completed results

C5k reached 20,000 successful updates under its three-hour cap. Full dev250 / 1,008 GT: AP55.8283 at10k and AP64.6957 at20k; select20k (SHA256 d9deacc85d1bf402cf6417a71226bd51e1fc98b631dcd30c9afcc22d51b51044). Relative to historical B20k: AP+0.9027, AP-small+0.2958, AP75+0.0857, AP-medium-8.7478. Small-object matching at IoU0.5 declined102 to99 while IoU0.75 improved35 to41. This is not evidence of data-expansion benefit.

D10k stopped at159 updates after explicit user stop; no checkpoint or dev AP exists. No restart or budget extension occurred. Existing u18000/0.3 downstream candidates remain unchanged.

### Revised full-data proposal, not executable

Raw C5k logs confirm40,000 image presentations in8,400.824 seconds (0.21002 seconds/image). Update timers account for98.995% of that time. Illustrative40,000 images at100 epochs therefore give233.36 training hours; this is old-throughput extrapolation, not actual full-data N or a measured accumulation8 runtime. Accumulation does not remove the sequential microbatch forward/backward work.

The recommended next experiment now starts from C5k20k model weights with new optimizer/scheduler/sampler state, retaining R50,768,scale0.5–2.0 and batch2. Train one full epoch; only a preregistered dev-benefit gate and sufficient remaining time allow a second. At illustrative N40000, including dev and overhead:2.43–2.88 hours for one epoch;4.87–5.76 hours for two. Proposed hard caps are3 hours per epoch including evaluation and6 hours total, no automatic extension/restart. Actual N must fit the upper planning bound before launch.

Continue after epoch1 only with a complete error-free report, AP75 no worse than baseline-0.5, and either AP+0.3 or AP no worse than baseline-0.2 with AP-small/weak-class macro+1.0. These are practical screening thresholds, not statistical significance. Select maximum complete dev AP including the existing C5k baseline; stop after epoch2 regardless.

The short proposal remains execution_enabled=false, training_authorized=false and runtime_ready=false. Existing full100 code is on a separate branch and hard-codes100 epochs, batch16, fresh COCO and no total wall deadline; it cannot run this proposal by merely changing JSON. Short-plan contract, model-only warmstart lineage and bounded conditional orchestration still require implementation. Historical CPU checks are reused, not rerun.

### Current dependencies and scope

Team branches, all five PRs and active discussions were checked. wkq b24515b adds149 language-training images within the existing10k and39 unreviewed language challenge-dev images; this adds no segmentation supervision. The reviewed642-query main language dev remains unchanged. wyz103dcc5 and main7064ebb are unchanged. Full segmentation-train release, actual N/hashes, incremental acceptance and freeze binding remain missing; language review is not a segmentation prerequisite.

At15:37 HKT GPU0MiB, no compute/active coordination, lock free. This follow-up read only existing numeric logs and source, checked arithmetic/JSON/doc links, and changed documentation plus a disabled proposal. Zero model loads, training updates, inference, smoke or historical test reruns. No server deployment, teammate changes, test access or new candidate export.

- [Timing evidence, shorter recipe, explicit stop rules and limitations](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/0b8a0a88119d4e68f9386e11b88b94d968e0d8d2/docs/handoffs/segmentation/full_data_short_plan_20261117.md)
- [Full-data release and incremental intake requirements](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/0b8a0a88119d4e68f9386e11b88b94d968e0d8d2/docs/handoffs/segmentation/full_fashionpedia_intake_20261117.md)
- [C5k results and D10k interruption](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/1ec972363271b5ba70be565de71d1b638dc7477c/docs/handoffs/segmentation/expansion_control_20261117.md)
- [Current team status](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/status.md)

Keep this PR draft and unmerged. Preparation branch changes are linked, not merged or deployed here.

项目需要统一、可追溯的数据和评价接口，避免试点标签、机器初标与正式测试结果混用。本 PR 汇总 data_eval 的真实数据转换、盲审与修订流程、共享规则解析器、B0 和统一评价核心，并交付版本化的大型数据包。

- 分割数据：5,000 train / 250 dev / 400 held-out test 图。保持官方边界，源 mask 不改写，validation 使用独立 ID 命名空间；哈希、资源地址及含镜像 pHash 保守分组。
- 语言数据：1,000 张训练图、1,580 组中英配对（3,160 条）；dev 116 图、145 组（290 条）。CPU 弱标注加有记录的 Codex 视觉修订，全部保持 needs_revision，新增 accepted 为 0；原小包 17 组 / 34 条 accepted 保留。
- 初标使用保守颜色条件、源纹样和几何；未知属性放弃判断。修订保留原文和证据，35 个按页审核页面不嵌入目标答案。accepted-only 正式评价门禁保持不变。

验证：远端独立 CPU 环境 93 项测试通过；五个包通过 schema/几何/hash 检查、独立 pycocotools 源 mask 逐像素一致性和候选裁剪检查；发布后逐文件 SHA256 核对。分割/训练查询/dev 查询分别视觉抽查 64/64/31 个目标；这不是全量质量认证。无 GPU 使用或模型训练。

限制：机器训练文件只供明确选择弱标注实验的输入；dev 仍有 134 张待补写，所有新增语言待人工审核。最终测试没有生成机器语言答案；新大包消费方验收、人工独立测试描述及三方正式冻结未完成。GT 试点诊断不是正式 dev/test 成绩。

详细路径、数据 hash、验证和下一步：[大型数据交接](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/data-eval/p3-baseline-evaluation/docs/handoffs/data_eval/large_dataset_20261112.md)；[P3 交接](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/data-eval/p3-baseline-evaluation/docs/handoffs/data_eval/p3_reviewed_baseline_20261112.md)。大型图片、标注输出和审核包保留在服务器共享数据盘，不提交 Git。

info.body:
接入 B 发布的 schema-3 候选、共享查询解析和统一评价器，提供锁定版本的 SigLIP 2 编码、冻结特征缓存、B1/B2 预测与规则覆盖率。新增只读流式数据验收，以及显式 train-only 的 M1 弱标注短试训入口；模型推理仅接收完整查询和候选，不读取人工答案字段。

依赖 #4：本 PR 暂以 data-eval/p3-baseline-evaluation 为 base，只展示 grounding 的改动；请先审核该接口依赖，再按团队流程调整 base。未合并 main。

实际验证：
- B 数据环境的 111 项联合测试通过；grounding 环境的 24 项专项测试通过（18 项接口测试有重叠）。数据构建依赖 NumPy 2，不能把 B 的构建测试直接当作 NumPy 1.26 模型环境测试；环境差异已记录。
- 6 个真实发布包：32,574 个哈希条目、25,715 份候选/COCO/源 mask 比对、逐图解码裁剪、查询引用、跨分区 ID/hash/group 隔离通过；计数含语言子集重复。
- 同一34条 accepted train 查询：B0 12/34（复现），B1 18/34，B2 22/34。B2 lambda=1为事先固定诊断值，未用train选参。完美/空输出/不完整预测等独立评价控制通过；B1/B2纯缓存重放完全一致。
- M1：1000图/3160条机器描述，冻结编码器，seed42固定5轮；同训练弱标签拟合78.07%→83.96%，检查点重放一致。未声称泛化提升；正式dev尚无accepted查询，M2和其他种子未运行。

交接与完整命令：docs/handoffs/grounding/accepted_baselines_and_weak_trial_20261112.md；小型证据索引已提交。数据、权重、缓存、凭据均不在PR内。
